newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 21.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Viacom Inc and MCA Inc of Seagram Co Ltd seemed prepared to settle their lawsuit on Sunday. Viacom would allegedly receive MCA's half of the USA Network worth up to $1.4 billion and give the company its half of the Sci-Fi Channel valued at $275 million in return. Viacom would also pay MCA an undisclosed amount of cash.
HOLLYWOOD - Relations between News Corp Ltd and its telco partner MCI Communications Group have deteriorated as MCI could reduce its role in American Sky Broadcasting and News Corp itself.
